messages:
Ava: Quick ask for runtime - we need a small reproducible probe for the launch post to support our latency claim. Not a full bench, just a tight, explainable snapshot.

Ava: Spec: 1) Models: redwood/santa-13b (stable), redwood/santa-13b-int8, redwood/santa-13b-int4. 2) Samples: 50 randomized prompts per variant. 3) Warmup: 10 prefix warmup requests, then measure. 4) RNG seed: 42 for reproducibility. 5) Outputs: median, p95, p99 latency; token-cost estimate; and 10 raw prompt->response pairs per variant (include server timestamps + trace id).

Ava: Payload example (vary user_id per sample):
```json
{"input": "Summarize the following in 2 sentences: <article_text>", "user_id": "user_<rand>", "trace_id": "mkt-spot-1765439998"}
```

Ava: If possible include one failed/timeout example in the artifacts for transparency.

Diego: Clarifying: use hosted catalog names above, correct? And hosted is fine unless capacity forces a tiny dedicated pool (call out in report).

Ava: Correct, hosted preferred. If you fall back to Dedicated, note it explicitly.

Priya: Timeline? I can queue checks today if we get sign-off. Also what is the marketing acceptance threshold?

Sam: Marketing target: on the sampled short-input workload, stable median <= 120ms (we can pick quantized variants if stable misses). We'll avoid headlining p99.

Diego: Implementation notes: - Use the same deterministic prompt list seeded with 42. - Warmup 10 requests to populate KV cache. - Measure end-to-end server-side latency (request received -> last token emitted). - Annotate cache hit/miss per run. Cost estimate ~ 150 measured runs * avg token length.

Diego: Planned run command (pseudo):
```bash
for variant in stable int8 int4; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood/santa-13b-'${variant}'","input":"Summarize the following in 2 sentences: <article_text>","max_tokens":200,"user":"mkt-spot"}' | jq . > out_${variant}_$(date +%s).json
done
```

Ava: Please upload raw JSON outputs and a CSV with latency percentiles per variant. Mark any runs with kv-cache=false.

Priya: We'll do a quick content-quality smoke: sample 10 outputs per variant to check for regressions. Where to drop artifacts?

Ava: Drop to gs://redwood-marketing/spotprobe-1765439998/ or /shared/marketing/bench/spotprobe-1765439998.zip and paste the link.

bench-bot: Job scheduled: job_id=mkt-spot-1765439998-run1, ETA ~ 35m. :mechanical_arm:

Diego: Starting warmup. Note: one warmup node had a transient GPU preemption - ignoring warmup retries but will surface if it impacts measured runs.

Diego: Stable run done - median=135ms, p95=280ms, p99=420ms. Prefix-cache hits ~86%. Uploading raw artifacts.

Ava: Median 135ms > 120ms target. Can you run a short-input follow-up (max_tokens=50, shorter prompts) 20 samples per variant to test sensitivity to input length? If that drops under 120ms we can narrow claim to short inputs.

Diego: Spinning short-input batch now (20 samples/variant).

Diego: Short-input results: stable median=98ms, p95=210ms, p99=330ms. int8 median=85ms, int4 median=82ms. Uploaded new artifacts and token-distribution note.

Priya: Running content-quality check on uploaded outputs. Flag: a couple of int4 long-prompt runs show truncated completions on the long set - minor but worth noting.

Ava: Great. Please draft a 1-paragraph summary with exact caveats (short-inputs vs long-context, seed, sample counts, percentiles) for the launch doc and paste the GCS link here.

Diego: Draft summary uploaded. Artifacts at gs://redwood-marketing/spotprobe-1765439998/ (CSV, raw JSONs, 10 sample pairs per variant, run metadata including kv-cache flags).

Ava: Thanks all. I'll add the paragraph to the launch and tag legal/comms. If we need an additional small rerun for clarity we'll reopen here. :tada:
